title: Notional overhead map of four UAP incidents reported by federal agents, western US, 2023
description: Grayscale overhead terrain image of desert and mountains with callouts and blue dots marking the "Observer position" for four incidents: "Orbs Launching Orbs", "Fiery Orb", "Dark Kite" and "Translucent Kite". Inset text calls it "a notional representation of four incidents reportedly involving unidentified anomalous phenomena (UAP) in the western United States", reported by U.S. federal law enforcement special agents "over a period of several days in October 2023". Illustrations of orange orbs, a large fiery orb and kite shapes appear near the callouts, and a note says all images were artificially generated (genai.mil) and that phenomena, scale and locations are not accurate. Marked UNCLASSIFIED.
